subject: Demo recap — one quick feedback ask
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@cortexai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap — one quick feedback ask

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Short recap and a single quick ask so we don’t waste your time: 

What we covered (very briefly):
- Redwood inference runtime overview + expected latencies for 8k context on A100s
- Dedicated vs hosted options and a proposed pilot path (2-week pilot, small dataset)
- Security controls: VPC + KMS integration and audit logs

Open items / proposed next steps:
1) Quick fit signal: does this align with Cortex AI’s priorities for Q2?
2) If yes, we can schedule a 15-minute kickoff to map data access and a minimal success metric.

Attachment: discovery-deck.pdf — 10 slides, focused on pilot scope and performance numbers.

If you prefer, here are two times I have open next week: Thu 9–9:30 PT or Fri 11–11:30 PT. Otherwise drop a time that works and I’ll book it.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Following up one last time this week. If I don’t hear back, I’ll assume the timing isn’t right and will check back later in the quarter. Before I pause, two tiny asks (takes < 60s):

- Quick fit response: Is Redwood relevant to Cortex AI right now? (yes / maybe / no)
- If maybe/yes — which of these is most helpful: a) 15min pilot kickoff, b) pilot scope + SOW review, c) a short technical Q&A with Ben?
